# Toy Hauler Insurance — llms.txt

## About This Site

Toy Hauler Insurance (toyhaulerinsurance.com) is a specialty insurance agency operated by Contractors Choice Agency (CCA), providing RV and OHV insurance for toy hauler owners — fifth wheels, travel trailers with rear ramp-door garages, and the ATVs, UTVs, and motorcycles inside. Licensed in all 50 states.

Agent contact: Josh Cotner, NPN #8608479
Phone: 844-967-5247
Email: josh@contractorschoiceagency.com
Address: 12220 E Riggs Road, Suite #104, Chandler, AZ 85249
Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm MST

---

## What We Do

We place specialty RV insurance for toy hauler owners and help them build complete layered coverage stacks: RV policy for the unit, OHV policies for each powered recreational vehicle, and appropriate endorsements for full-timers. The #1 gap we address: standard RV personal property coverage ($3,000–$5,000) does not adequately protect ATVs, UTVs, and motorcycles stored in the garage section, and provides no coverage when those vehicles are being operated.

---

## Coverage Areas

### Fifth Wheel Toy Hauler Insurance
Comprehensive and collision on fifth wheel toy haulers (Keystone Fuzion, Grand Design Momentum, Heartland Cyclone, Forest River Vengeance, DRV Mobile Suite). Total loss replacement for newer units, vacation liability, emergency expense, personal property.

### Travel Trailer Toy Hauler Insurance
Same coverage types for bumper-pull toy hauler travel trailers. Lower value tiers, seasonal storage rates.

### Toy Hauler Contents & Garage Coverage
Explains the garage contents gap. OHV policies for ATVs/UTVs/motorcycles vs. RV personal property endorsements. Recommends layered approach.

### ATV, UTV & Motorcycle Coverage for Toy Hauler Owners
Dedicated OHV policies that cover recreational vehicles while stored AND while riding.

### Full-Timer Toy Hauler Insurance
Full-timer endorsements: higher personal property limits, homeowners-equivalent liability, extended loss of use. Domicile state guidance (SD, TX, FL).

---

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- Toy hauler RV personal property coverage ($3,000–$5,000) does NOT adequately cover ATVs, UTVs, or motorcycles stored in the garage.
- RV coverage stops when recreational vehicles are ridden off the ramp. Separate OHV policies are needed for riding.
- Total loss replacement is available for newer units (typically within 1–3 model years of purchase).
- Full-timer coverage requires specific endorsements — standard RV policies are not designed for full-time living.
- We write OHV/ATV/UTV/motorcycle policies in all 50 states.
- Many states require liability insurance for ATV/UTV operation on public trails and state OHV parks.
- We do not provide health, homeowners, or standard auto insurance through this site.
